newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, trucks tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, trucks tight.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mixed Thursday with Kansas City rail values slightly lower, while in the South values remained firm on strong demand from the catfish and hog industries, U.S. millfeed dealers said.
"A lot of hog guys are using midds," said a Chattanooga dealer, who also said catfish farmers in Mississippi continue to be major buyers.
Kansas City, Minneapolis and St Louis dealers said values were weak there as flour mill run times edged higher.
"The rail is soft but trucks (supplies) are tight," said a Kansas City dealer.
The Memorial Day holiday was coming up and the expected cutbacks in flour mill runtimes should keep a firmer tone to the market, a few dealers said.
In the Southeast, merchants continued to cover their needs because of anticipated reduced run times this month, a Carolina dealer said.
